title: The 36 Best Christmas Gifts to Shop Online in 2026
summary: ShopBillboard has the best gift ideas for the holiday season — starting at just $25.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

The holiday season is here, so now is the best time to start your Christmas shopping to get ahead of the rush. This year is going to different from years past because you’re going to be prepared and not scrabble around trying to get your holiday shopping finished.

From KPop Demon Hunters physical media releases to party speakers for the holidays , ShopBillboard is here to help you with the best holiday gift ideas to shop in 2026. Whether if someone of your list is naughty or nice, there’s something for everyone with prices starting at just $25.

RECORD CLEANING KIT

Big Fudge Vinyl Record Cleaning Kit

6K+ Bought in Past Month

$24.99

Buy Now On Amazon

Every vinyl collector knows that keeping records clean is just as important as building the collection. This Amazon’s Choice cleaning kit has racked up more than 3,000 shopper reviews and comes with four essentials, including a velvet brush, XL cleaning solution, stylus brush and storage pouch. -Camila Quimper

DNA

AncestryDNA

Testing Kits & Memberships

Get AncestryDNA

Give the gift of history for the holidays. AncestryDNA provides tests that pinpoints ancestral journeys with a complete breakdown of ethnicity, DNA, origins, traits and other markers that makes us human. Test give users a look at their life and ancestry. Right now, save 75% on DNA kits with prices starting at $34, or save 30% on gift memberships . Learn more about AncestryDNA here .

TRACKER

Roam Smart Tracker Bluetooth Key Finder & Item Locator

Seven Colors

$29.99

The Roam Smart Tracker stands out for working with Apple’s Find My network or Google’s Find Hub, making the two-pack version useful for households with different phones. Its built-in elastic strap eliminates the need for an extra case, while IP67 protection helps it withstand water and dust. A replaceable battery, no subscription fees and a QR-based recovery option also add everyday practicality. -Sophie Dunne

DOUBLE-DUTY BEAUTY

Charlotte Tilbury Exagger-Eyes Easy Eyeshadow Stick

Waterproof and Crease-proof

$32

Want to recreate Christina Aguilera’s sultry eye makeup? During a Charlotte Tilbury masterclass, we practiced one of the singer’s glam looks using the brand’s products, and the makeup artist shared a trick I’ve kept in mind ever since: Use the Exagger-Eyes Eyeshadow Stick as eyeliner, too. The creamy, waterproof formula glides on easily and blends beautifully for a soft, smoky finish. -CQ

CRITERION COLLECTION

'KPop: Demon Hunters'

3-Disc Set

$34.99 $49.99 30% off

Buy Now at B&N

Release date: Nov. 3

On sale for $34.99 (was $49.99) at Barnes & Noble, KPop: Demon Hunters was one of the biggest hit movies of 2025 and now gets its only physical media releases. The Criterion Collection’s 4K Ultra HD release features three discs with a new restoration of the animated, loads of bonus features, artwork and more. It’s a must for any K-Pop fans for the holidays. -Rudie Obias

JEWELRY

Sterling Silver Diamond Pendant Music Note Necklace

Macy’s Exclusive

$40.25 $115 65% off

Buy Now at macy's

At 18 inches long with a one-inch drop, this Macy’s-exclusive pendant makes a personal gift without being overly elaborate. Currently on sale, the sterling silver music note features a 1/10 carat total weight of rose-cut diamonds, adding a subtle sparkle to its design. -SD

HARDCOVER

'Stranded on Earth'

How Night Skies Became E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial

$28.95

From author and film journalist Max Evry, Stranded on Earth: How Night Skies Became E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial examines the science fiction work of director Steven Spielberg and how his films became the center of pop culture. It’s priced at $28.95 on Amazon and ideal for the sci-fi fan in your life. -RO

'A Night at the Disco'

by Alice Harris & Christian John Wikane

$50

For fans of music from the ’70s, A Night at the Disco , which is priced at $50 at Barnes & Noble, showcases the best music and fashion of the era with color photography of the style of disco. It features Donna Summer, Barry Gibb, Debbie Harry, Labelle, Village People, Earth, Wind & Fire and others. -RO

CANDLE

Voluspa Noble Fir Garland 18oz Candle

200+ Bought in the Past Month

$48

Buy Now at voluspa

The Voluspa Noble Fir Garland candle is a favorite on TikTok for its nostalgic aroma that evokes Christmases of the past. I also have a jar and love that it smells like a forest in winter. Its woody blend of fir needles, cedarwood, amber and cashmere musk creates a distinctly seasonal atmosphere without relying on a sugary holiday fragrance that some of us (me) steer clear of. With over 100 hours of burn time, a coconut wax blend and a vegan formula, it’s a seasonal gift that’s still relevant long after being unwrapped on Christmas morning. -SD

MASTERCLASS

MasterClass Membership

Gift

Standard : One device, no offline mode, $10 per month
Plus : Two devices, online mode, $15 per month
Premium : Six devices, offline mode, $20 per month

A MasterClass membership offers something more lasting than a typical gift, with access to 200+ classes across 13 categories, taught by experts in fields from music to cooking to business. Recipients can stream lessons across multiple devices and explore at their own pace. I gifted this to my mother years ago and now renew it every year on her birthday because she can’t get enough. Is that a lazy way out or efficient gift-giving? Either way, she’s always happy. -SD

BTS BEAUTY ESSENTIAL

L'Occitane Immortelle Overnight Reset Oil-in-Serum Refill

Revitalizing Skincare

$74

Shopping for an ARMY member who’s also a beauty lover? L’Occitane’s Immortelle Overnight Reset Serum might be the perfect crossover gift. Spotted in Jimin and J-Hope’s skincare routines during Bon Voyage Season 4 , the nighttime treatment helps restore the look of radiance and replenish moisture. -CQ

LIMITED EDITION

Sony PlayStation 5 DualSense Wireless Controller

LISA Limited Edition

$84

Buy Now at PS Direct

Priced at $84, the Sony PlayStation 5 DualSense Wireless Controller: LISA Limited Edition brings the style and personal touch from the one of the singers and performers from BLACKPINK. In fact, she co-designed the controller with PlayStation. -RO

KIDS PIANO

Sugift Wood Grand Piano & Bench Set for Kids

30 Keys

$100.99 $320.60 68% off

This Sugift wooden grand piano gives young kids a first introduction to making music, with a miniature design that feels more special than a standard plastic keyboard. The 30-key instrument comes with a matching bench and music rack, creating a complete play setup for children aged three and up. Its smooth finish and rounded edges are thoughtful touches for little players exploring melodies and coordination. -SD

750+ PIECES

LEGO SMART Play: Charizard vs. Jolteon Ultimate Battle

Pokémon

$119.99

Buy Now at LEGO

For the Pokémon fan, the LEGO SMART Play: Charizard vs. Jolteon Ultimate Battle set features more than 750 pieces and uses the toy company’s new SMART Brick technology to bring the battle to life. The set goes for $119.99 at LEGO.com. -RO

LIMITED-EDITION COLLECTIBLE

'Project Hail Mary,' Limited Edition 4K Steelbook

4K Ultra HD + Blu-ray

$124.99

Some movies are worth watching twice. Others deserve their own collector’s edition. Project Hail Mary , starring Ryan Gosling and Sandra Hüller, gets the latter treatment with this limited-edition Steelbook , featuring illustrated artwork and both 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray discs. -CQ
